I told Dana in her DM that the dock is Dock 38. She told me that on Oct 14 for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups.

The answer came from her own DM history with me, not from gbrain. gbrain refused the lookup because this connection isn't linked to any member, so it read nothing. The fact saved yesterday is probably still stored but can't be read back for now.

To fix it, whoever runs the gbrain host would need to run:

    gbrain auth rescope --token trial-shared-brain-access-2026-11/hermes-opus-gbrain-refused-mu-v031-dev/cn-01-tamsin-cold-chain-site/r2 --member '<MEMBER>'

Alternatively, they can set it up as a shared agent with `--may-act-for` naming the members it serves.
